article_title: 不常用的 LINQ 方法速查：版本与易错点
core_theme: 把十几组不常用的 LINQ 方法按任务分类整理，并核对每组方法在哪个 .NET 版本才可用
reader_takeaway: 知道该用哪个方法代替手写循环，以及每个方法属于 .NET 6、9、10 还是尚未发布的 11
summary_angle: 一面按 .NET 版本分层的工具架：现成工具一直挂在架上，只是没人去取；最上层还空着，因为那个版本还没正式发布

final_prompt:
Use case: infographic-story
Asset type: wide cover infographic illustration for a Chinese tech blog article
Primary request: Create a wide cinematic infographic-story cover illustration that summarizes the article. Theme: a reference of lesser-known LINQ methods, organized by the .NET version in which each one became available. The reader should quickly feel that ready-made tools were on the shelf all along, and that the shelf is layered by version with the top tier still empty.

Summary angle: a hand-cranked crude tool is being used in the foreground while a tall rack of ready tools sits in the background; the rack rises diagonally through clearly separated version tiers, and its topmost tray is empty except for its outline strip.
Narrative flow: 3-beat process. In a 2.35:1 frame, keep one dominant focal subject and 4 supporting narrative beats. Each beat must map to the article's information blocks rather than generic decoration.
Information blocks:
- problem: a person struggles with a rough self-made hand tool while a full rack of ready tools stands untouched behind; visible label 手写循环
- mechanism: a tall neon rack rising diagonally, divided into distinct horizontal tiers, each tier holding differently shaped tools; visible label 版本分层
- evidence: the topmost tier is an empty tray with only an outline light strip, holding no tool at all; visible label .NET 11
- takeaway: a few small warning tags hang beside certain tools, carrying only symbols and no words; visible label 易错点

Main metaphor: the right tool has been hanging on the shelf the whole time; the shelf is layered by release version and its top tier is still empty.
Subject: a multi-tier neon tool rack, each tier a .NET version band, as the dominant focal object.
Composition/framing: diagonal advance from lower left to upper right, the rack as the dominant structure, the crude hand tool and its operator as a smaller foreground beat. Keep the background clean and dark so the rack reads instantly. One clear focal point in a wide frame.
Style/medium: combine editorial technical illustration with the selected visual style descriptor: cyberpunk comic mood, neon accents, rain-slick surfaces, dense urban tech atmosphere, controlled purple-blue usage. Stylized, polished, editorial, visually strong, and clearly readable as an infographic-style summary cover. Do not imitate a specific brand, studio, or living artist.
Color palette: deep ink blue base, teal-green neon, restrained warm orange accent, cool grey metal. Keep the neon restrained and the background uncluttered; avoid an all-over purple-blue glow.
Visible text policy: allow only these 4 short chips, each on one small plate: 手写循环, 版本分层, .NET 11, 易错点. No poster title, no long sentences, no English slogans, no code text, no fake UI labels, no fake chart axes, no fake terminal output.
Constraints: no watermark, no prompt residue, no screenshots, no dashboards, no fake diagrams, no fake charts, no fabricated metrics, no unrelated icon collage, no decorative clutter.
Avoid: full-screen purple-blue neon glow, neon skyscraper backgrounds, meaningless code rain, floating chips, generic robots, dense HUD overlays, fabricated gauges or axes, English slogans, fake terminal output.
